candidates.title: 🚨 Someone built a FR££ CapCut replacement: no watermark, no account, 100% offline

candidates.why_tr: Haftada +1510 yıldız; CapCut'ın paywall ve watermark acısını çözüyor, MCP/CLI ile ajanlarla da kullanılabiliyor.
facts: README: free open-source CapCut alternative for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android
No watermark, no account, no subscription, no upload
Auto-captions with local Whisper
170+ effects, filters, transitions and text animations
Export H.264, HEVC, AV1 up to 4K 60, 10-bit
JSON-RPC, gRPC and MCP API plus a CLI so AI agents can cut video

On-device captions that work offline
Export to MP4 or GIF with GPU encoding
Windows: winget / Microsoft Store or .exe; macOS 13+ .dmg; Linux .deb/.rpm/.AppImage
15 interface languages
